igl_gabaergic_neuron.label: GABAergic neuron
igl_gabaergic_neuron.note: No IGL- or thalamus-specific GABAergic CL term found. CL:0000617 is a generic parent only. Potential CL contribution.

igl_npy_geniculohypothalamic_neuron.label: NPY interneuron
igl_npy_geniculohypothalamic_neuron.note: Shares NPY+/GABAergic identity, but CL term is an interneuron (cortical layers II-III/VI, medial geniculate, inferior colliculus); IGL NPY cells are SCN-projecting projection neurons, so not BROAD/EXACT. No definition references in the OLS record.

igl_enkephalinergic_geniculogeniculate_n.note: No CL term found for enkephalin neuron in CNS (only sympathetic ganglion and myenteric enkephalin neurons). Potential CL contribution.

lgv_igl_gabaergic_neuron.label: GABAergic neuron
lgv_igl_gabaergic_neuron.note: Existing parent KB node; no thalamic/LGv/IGL-specific CL term found (searches: intergeniculate leaflet neuron, GABAergic neuron of thalamus, lateral geniculate nucleus GABAergic neuron all empty).
